data.body: [P2] Document the external assumptions required by CONTRIBUTING rule 6. The description asserts that these caller/callee permissions enable issue-comment writes and that the token posts as `github-actions[bot]`, but supplies neither documentation/run evidence nor an “unverified” designation. The fetch mock does not validate permissions or posting identity. Return to the design phase under rule 9 and cite supporting GitHub documentation or a real run, or explicitly mark these assumptions unverified for maintainer review.
